items.title: Why U.S. Islands Are Important for Biodiversity
items.summary: Along with the more well-known islands like the Aleutian and Hawaiian Islands, the United States is home to thousands of islands found much closer to the mainland, scattered along coastlines, tucked inside estuaries, and forming barrier islands that separate coastal wetlands from the open ocean .

items.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
items.summary: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock from Anthropic at the initial public offering price.
